items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Sarah Vaughan all then. Nobody said nothin' about it.

ctx.x: I did, and I overdid it. Because a guy wrote me up about it and said 'he's all right, but he plays too many of those things'. But all of us was doin' it. Not only me, but I guess I did it a little more than the rest. But it was a challenge among ourselves. Then when everybody else started doin' in Ella do it all the time, Sarah Vaughan all then. Nobody said nothin' about it. And they still do it. But like I said, I probably overdid it.
